references.text: The same rationale for the Sabbath: The Lord created the heavens and the earth in six days and rested on the seventh day.
The Sabbath as a sign between God and the children of Israel, an everlasting covenant.
The creation account where God finished his work in six days and rested on the seventh day and made it holy.
The commandment about the Sabbath in the Ten Commandments, referencing creation as its foundation.
The Sabbath as a sign between the Lord and Israel so that they may know that he is the Lord who makes them holy.
The Sabbath as a sign between God and his people, repeated in Ezekiel.
Early instruction about Sabbath rest in connection with the manna in the wilderness.
The commandment about the Sabbath repeated in Deuteronomy.
Hebrews refers to the fact that God rested on the seventh day from all his works.
Genesis 2:2 documents the event that Exodus 31:17 uses as the foundation for the covenant sign.
